tagline: Blue Origin's first-generation lunar cargo lander — single-stage hydrogen / oxygen vehicle, ~3 t to the surface
description: Single-stage cryogenic lander built around the LH₂ / LOX BE-7 engine. Mk1 is the cargo-only precursor to the much larger Mk2 crewed Artemis HLS variant; both share the BE-7 propulsion and hydrogen-based reusability architecture. Launches on Blue Origin's New Glenn — the Mk1 pathfinder rode the maiden NG-1 flight on 2025-01-16. Cargo Mk1 delivers up to ~3000 kg to the lunar surface; the crewed Mk2 derivative anchored Blue Origin's HLS contract awarded by NASA in 2023 as the second Artemis-era human lander alongside SpaceX Starship HLS.
best_known_for: Blue Origin cargo lunar lander — BE-7 hydrogen propulsion, ~3 t to the surface, NASA CLPS
